headline: Microsoft has launched Copilot for legal, more than 20 legal skills for Word and its Cowork agent tool.
score_reason: Confirmed company announcement; only a short excerpt of the article was readable and the reach is specialist.
importance_line: Lawyers and legal teams that already use Word get AI helpers for legal work built in, which pushes Microsoft against dedicated legal software, though the excerpt does not describe what the skills do or how well.
summary: Law.com reports that Microsoft announced on Thursday Copilot for legal, a set of more than 20 purpose-built legal skills for its Copilot chatbot, delivered as two plugins, one for Microsoft Word and one for Cowork, Microsoft's agentic AI offering that can carry out tasks across its applications. It builds on features first shown in Microsoft's Legal Agent in April.
notes: Only the opening of the article was readable (paywall or excerpt), about 1,300 characters.
